question: In a double-stranded DNA sample adenine makes up $22\%$ of the bases. What percentage is guanine?
anchor: Chargaff's rules: $A = T$ and $G = C$, so $2A + 2G = 100\%$.
why: Chargaff's rules: $A = T$ and $G = C$, so $2A + 2G = 100\%$. $T = A = 22\%$, so $G + C = 100 - 2\times 22$ $G = \dfrac{100 - 2A}{2} = 28\%$

why: $\text{BMI} = \dfrac{\text{mass (kg)}}{\text{height (m)}^2}$. $\text{BMI} = \dfrac{50}{(1.7)^2}$ $\text{BMI} = 17.3\ \text{kg m}^{-2}$

question: A population grows at $1\%$ per year. Using the rule of 70, estimate its doubling time in years.
anchor: Doubling time $\approx \dfrac{70}{\text{growth rate in } \%}$.
why: Doubling time $\approx \dfrac{70}{\text{growth rate in } \%}$. $t_d \approx \dfrac{70}{1}$ $t_d \approx 70\ \text{years}$
